name: decide-adr
description: Triggers: "ADR for {decision}", "adr for {slug}", "document the decision on {topic}", "lock in the decision about {X}", "MADR for {topic}", "/sdlc:decide-adr {slug} {title}", "create ADR for a decision", "document the decision", "ADR on {topic}". Use to record a post-hoc or asynchronous architecture decision as a MADR ADR when it was NOT captured during the synchronous architecture-design pass — a choice made in code, in a chat, on a whiteboard, or one a break-tasks / review gate flagged as missing. Confirms the decision is ADR-worthy via the blast-radius gate, picks the next 4-digit number, copies architecture-design's MADR template, and fills context / drivers / considered options / outcome / honest consequences. Supports a Proposed → Accepted review flow. Output: docs/features/{slug}/adr/NNNN-{title}.md. For decisions made live with the user, use sdlc:architecture-design — it spawns ADRs inline (Accepted).
